content.text: Paintings by Harley Weir presents images made as a form of digression from the artists' traditional photographic practice. Known for her intimate and striking approach to portraiture, the images in Paintings attempt to erase from the frame her concerns with trust, power and permission that weigh upon the act of photographing others.
